sn12.22:1.2: dasabalasamannāgato bhikkhave tathāgato catūhi ca vesārajjehi samannāgato āsabhaṇṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti
sn12.22:1.3: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo
sn12.22:1.4: iti vedanā iti vedanāya samudayo iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo
sn12.22:1.5: iti saññā iti saññāya samudayo iti saññāya atthaṅgamo
sn12.22:1.6: iti saṅkhārā iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo
sn12.22:1.7: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo
sn12.22:1.8: iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti imassuppādā idaṃ uppajjati
sn12.22:1.9: imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati
sn12.22:2.1: evaṃ svākkhāto bhikkhave mayā dhammo uttāno vivaṭo pakāsito chinnapilotiko.
sn12.22:2.2: evaṃ svākkhāte kho bhikkhave mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike alameva saddhāpabbajitena kulaputtena viriyaṃ ārabhituṃ
sn12.22:2.3: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yantaṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā purisassa viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti.
sn12.22:3.1: dukkhaṃ bhikkhave kusīto viharati vokiṇṇo pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi mahantañca sadatthaṃ parihāpeti.
sn12.22:3.2: āraddhaviriyo ca kho bhikkhave sukhaṃ viharati pavivitto pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi mahantañca sadatthaṃ paripūreti.
sn12.22:3.3: na bhikkhave hīnena aggassa patti hoti
sn12.22:3.4: aggena ca kho aggassa patti hoti.
sn12.22:3.6: tasmātiha bhikkhave viriyaṃ ārabhatha appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya
sn12.22:3.7: evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ pabbajjā avaṃkatā avañjhā bhavissati saphalā saudrayā
sn12.22:3.8: yesaṃ mayaṃ paribhuñjāma cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mahānisaṃsāti
sn12.22:3.10: attatthaṃ vā hi bhikkhave sampassamānena alameva appamādena sampādetuṃ.
sn12.22:3.11: paratthaṃ vā hi bhikkhave sampassamānena alameva appamādena sampādetuṃ.
sn12.22:3.12: ubhayatthaṃ vā hi bhikkhave sampassamānena alameva appamādena sampādetunti.
